grounding_prompts: Look around and find three green things
Feel the weight of your feet on the ground
Put the phone down, pour a glass of water and drink it slowly
Listen: what is the farthest sound you can hear?
Let your shoulders relax and sink a little
Look out the window at the farthest point and rest your eyes
Touch something nearby and notice its warmth and texture
Stand up and stretch, letting your back slowly lengthen
Think of one small thing that went well today
Take a deep breath and notice what the air smells like
Find the brightest color in front of you and rest your eyes on it
Talk to someone nearby, or look up at the sky
grounding_prompts_bedtime: Charge your phone somewhere out of reach
Dim the lights in your room a little
Tomorrow's things can wait until tomorrow
Breathe out slowly and let your shoulders relax
Take a small sip of warm water and get ready for bed
Think of one small thing you're grateful for today
Pull up the covers and let yourself get warm
Close your eyes and listen to the quiet of the room
